title: Revamp of Bus Routes Given Staged Opening of Thomson-East Coast Line
what_it_is: Revamp of Bus Routes Given Staged Opening of Thomson-East Coast Line

sections.label: Bus services and subsidies
sections.summary: In 2019, 11 of 356 bus services covered operating costs, with about $1 billion in Government subsidies; in 2020 only two feeder services did.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: In 2019, we have a total of 356 bus services.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Only 11 services could generate fare revenue that covered operating costs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The difference was made up by Government subsidies amounting to about $1 billion.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: In 2020, with public transport ridership falling due to COVID-19, only two feeder services were able to generate revenues to cover their operating costs.

sections.label: Feeder services and subsidies
sections.summary: In 2020 only two feeder services generated enough revenue to cover operating costs, with the rest covered by Government subsidies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: As I mentioned in my main reply, only two feeder services are able to generate enough revenue to cover operating costs in 2020.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: For the rest of the services, we are covering through Government subsidies from the $1 billion pool of total public funds that I mentioned.

sections.label: Balancing subsidies and sustainability
sections.summary: The Government must balance service quality, fare affordability and financial sustainability, as rising subsidies become financially unsustainable and increase the fiscal burden.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Mathematically, I think it will be clear to everybody that the total amount of public subsidies would have to go up.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: The concern with doing that is over time, it becomes financially unsustainable and we are increasing the fiscal burden for this generation and the next generation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Therefore, the Government has to strike a balance between a few important considerations: quality of service, fare affordability for commuters and financial sustainability of our public transport system.
